rules: Line height: leading-none for headers, leading-relaxed for body
Do NOT use Inter for any headings
Ensure text contrasts meet APCA standards against backgrounds
Use typography to create a warm, approachable, but structured hierarchy
Use Warm beige and Cream for backgrounds
Avoid excessive gradients and neon colors
No luxury black/gold. Keep it natural, organic, and accessible
Color exists to guide action and build a 'furniture workshop' familiarity

visual_enhancers.corners: Soft rounded corners, rounded-2xl for major cards, rounded-xl for inputs
visual_enhancers.shadows: Subtle ambient shadows only, e.g., shadow-sm on hover. No harsh or overly large shadows.
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise or wood grain overlay (max 3-5% opacity) if needed for warmth, though keep it extremely subtle so it stays modern.

layouts.mobile: Mobile-first approach. Large touch targets (min 48px height) for all interactable elements.
layouts.spacing: Generous whitespace. Use p-4 to p-6 inside cards. gap-6 to gap-8 between sections.
layouts.sticky_elements: Sticky bottom price summary on mobile detail pages. Sticky 'Pesan Sekarang' CTA.

components.product_card: Placeholder image (bg-stone-100 flex items-center justify-center) with text 'Foto produk segera tersedia'. Followed by simple, clean text hierarchy below.
components.forms: Use Shadcn components but style with warm beige backgrounds and border_subtle.
components.price_summary: Fixed at bottom on mobile (`fixed bottom-0 left-0 w-full z-50 p-4 bg-white/90 backdrop-blur-md border-t border-stone-200 shadow-[0_-4px_16px_rgba(0,0,0,0.05)]`).
components.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full) or soft rounded (rounded-xl) with solid primary color for main CTA. Large size for mobile to ensure ease of tapping.

hero_texture.description: Subtle wood texture for optional low-opacity background usage.

icons.style: Simple, clean, minimal stroke width (1.5 or 2). Avoid overly complex icons.

instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: DO NOT generate fake product photography. Use neutral beige/gray placeholder boxes with the text 'Foto produk segera tersedia'.
Ensure all interactive elements have `data-testid` attributes (kebab-case, role-based).
Implement a fixed/sticky bottom bar for mobile containing the total price and checkout CTA on product configuration pages.
Build the UI primarily in Bahasa Indonesia as requested.
Do NOT use complete transparent backgrounds in headers or overlays if content scrolls underneath.
Focus heavily on the 'Product detail + guided configuration form'. Use large, easy-to-tap selector buttons/cards for sizes, levels, and finishing, rather than small native dropdowns on mobile.
Admin dashboard should follow the same warm but clean design logic, maintaining high usability.
Include the standard placeholder logo space ('Sogil Furniture') in the header as an icon+text combo.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Make creative, distinctive frontends that feel warm and human.
Don't make generic centered layouts. Use optical alignment.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions. Static = dead.
Never use AI assistant Emoji characters for icons.
Ensure the application strictly follows the mobile-first CSS architecture since many customers arrive via WhatsApp.
